recipes.name: mmdet3d_pointpillars_car
recipes.command:
source "/home/datacity/miniforge3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh" &&
conda activate lidar-3d-base &&
env   NEILSON_CAR_KITTI_ROOT="/home/datacity/lidar-analytics/data/neilson_car_kitti"   python -c "import torch; ok=torch.cuda.is_available(); print(ok, torch.cuda.get_device_name(0) if ok else 'no-gpu'); raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)" &&
env   NEILSON_CAR_KITTI_ROOT="/home/datacity/lidar-analytics/data/neilson_car_kitti"   python "/home/datacity/lidar-analytics/experiments/neilson_car/scripts/prepare_mmdet_infos.py" &&
mkdir -p "/home/datacity/lidar-analytics/experiments/neilson_car/runs/mmdet3d_pointpillars_car_finetune" &&
cd "/home/datacity/src/mmdetection3d" &&
env   NEILSON_CAR_KITTI_ROOT="/home/datacity/lidar-analytics/data/neilson_car_kitti"   NVCC_PREPEND_FLAGS="${NVCC_PREPEND_FLAGS-}"   MPLCONFIGDIR="${MPLCONFIGDIR:-/tmp/matplotlib}"   XDG_CACHE_HOME="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-/tmp/.cache}"   MMDET3D_LOAD_FROM="/home/datacity/lidar-analytics/experiments/neilson_car/checkpoints/mmdet3d_pointpillars_kitti.pth"   MMDET3D_TRAIN_WORKERS="12"   MMDET3D_VAL_WORKERS="12"   MMDET3D_VAL_INTERVAL="25"   PYTHONPATH="/home/datacity/src/mmdetection3d"   python "/home/datacity/src/mmdetection3d/tools/train.py"   "/home/datacity/lidar-analytics/experiments/neilson_car/configs/mmdet3d_pointpillars_car.py"   --work-dir "/home/datacity/lidar-analytics/experiments/neilson_car/runs/mmdet3d_pointpillars_car_finetune"   --cfg-options train_cfg.val_interval=25 train_cfg.max_epochs=24

recipes.name: openpcdet_pointpillar_car
recipes.command:
source "/home/datacity/miniforge3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh" &&
conda activate lidar-openpcdet &&
env NEILSON_CAR_KITTI_ROOT="/home/datacity/lidar-analytics/data/neilson_car_kitti" python "/home/datacity/lidar-analytics/experiments/neilson_car/scripts/bootstrap_openpcdet_runtime.py" &&
env   NEILSON_CAR_KITTI_ROOT="/home/datacity/lidar-analytics/data/neilson_car_kitti"   PYTHONPATH="/tmp/openpcdet_patched:/tmp/openpcdet_extra_py${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}"   python "/home/datacity/lidar-analytics/experiments/neilson_car/scripts/require_cuda.py" --label openpcdet &&
test -d "/tmp/openpcdet_patched/tools" &&
env   NEILSON_CAR_KITTI_ROOT="/home/datacity/lidar-analytics/data/neilson_car_kitti"   PYTHONPATH="/tmp/openpcdet_patched:/tmp/openpcdet_extra_py${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}"   python -c "import runpy; runpy.run_path('/home/datacity/lidar-analytics/experiments/neilson_car/scripts/prepare_openpcdet_infos.py', run_name='__main__')" &&
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import yaml
src = Path("/home/datacity/lidar-analytics/experiments/neilson_car/configs/openpcdet_pointpillar_car.yaml")
dst = Path("/tmp/openpcdet_pointpillar_car.subset.yaml")
payload = yaml.safe_load(src.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
payload["DATA_CONFIG"]["DATA_PATH"] = "/home/datacity/lidar-analytics/data/neilson_car_kitti"
dst.write_text(yaml.safe_dump(payload, sort_keys=False), encoding="utf-8")
print(dst)
PY
cd "/tmp/openpcdet_patched/tools" &&
env   NEILSON_CAR_KITTI_ROOT="/home/datacity/lidar-analytics/data/neilson_car_kitti"   NVCC_PREPEND_FLAGS="${NVCC_PREPEND_FLAGS-}"   PYTHONPATH="/tmp/openpcdet_patched:/tmp/openpcdet_extra_py${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}"   python -c "import runpy, sys; sys.argv=['train.py', '--cfg_file', '/tmp/openpcdet_pointpillar_car.subset.yaml', '--extra_tag', 'neilson_pointpillar_finetune', '--workers', '12', '--batch_size', '4', '--epochs', '24', '--pretrained_model', '/home/datacity/lidar-analytics/experiments/neilson_car/checkpoints/openpcdet_pointpillar_kitti.pth']; runpy.run_path('/tmp/openpcdet_patched/tools/train.py', run_name='__main__')"
